Projects

Ventures built with communities, not just for them.

Each project starts from a real challenge identified with real people. Today the chapter runs four: livelihoods for artisans, gardeners and potters, community care, and pandemic-era health education.

Livelihoods

Project Kalakaari

Kalakaari works with artisan communities to create and sell handmade canvas bags — a durable, eco-friendly alternative to plastic — while generating employment for underprivileged women.

Explore the project →

Also running

Livelihoods

Project Srijan

Srijan supports local gardeners and potters by helping them reach buyers for their plants and handcrafted pots — from potted-plant combinations sold on campus to curated hampers.

Explore the project →

Community care

Project Samvedna

Samvedna works with people facing mental and emotional challenges, providing emotional support and raising awareness of mental health — while extending reuse-based support to community foundations.

Explore the project →

Health awareness

Project Niramaya

Niramaya began during the COVID-19 pandemic, combining practical hygiene support with education and awareness on mental, physical and emotional well-being.

Explore the project →

Areas of work

Our projects currently sit across 3 areas — Livelihoods , Community care and Health awareness . We organise the directory by project rather than category, because most ventures touch more than one issue at once.

Ready to collaborate on a project, propose a new one, or join as a student? Join us or see partner options.

E Enactus ARSD

Enactus ARSD is the student-led Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. We use entrepreneurial action to create livelihoods, dignity and well-being in the communities around our campus.
